notes: Eufy Security (by Anker) consumer cameras do not publish fixed RTSP URL templates in any official documentation. RTSP must be enabled per-device in the Eufy Security app (Camera Settings > General > Storage > RTSP/NAS), and the app generates and displays the device-specific RTSP URL. Official KB articles consistently say 'input the RTSP link shown in the App' without specifying a path. HomeBase-connected models (eufyCam series) stream via the HomeBase IP, not the camera itself. Standalone wired indoor/SoloCam models stream directly from the camera IP. Battery-powered outdoor cameras generally do not support RTSP. The /live0 path is the most commonly community-reported app-generated path, but it is not officially documented as a static template.
